lead.headline: Senior Engineer Ships for Nine Years
lead.deck: From APIs to data pipelines, he builds backends that stay fast, stay up and scale.

portrait.caption: R Ravikiran Jonnapalli, Senior Software Engineer.

story: R Ravikiran Jonnapalli is a senior software engineer with 9+ years in full-stack development, most of it on the MEAN stack. His work centres on backend optimization, API design and scalable systems that integrate cleanly across cloud platforms.
Since May 2017 he has worked at three companies: Way2Online, Rythmos and Cameo Global.
Outside work he builds in the open: rniverse, a set of TypeScript services and libraries that run on Bun, and Tend, a desktop app for notes and tasks.

items.name: tend
items.text: A quiet desktop app for notes, tasks, people and a library. Notes are plain Markdown files in a folder you pick.

items.name: aham
items.text: A central authentication service. It issues signed JWTs and publishes a public key endpoint, so any other service can verify tokens locally.

items.name: notify
items.text: A central notification service. Email sending sits behind a queued, retried and audited pipeline.

items.name: connectors
items.text: One connection model for PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB and Kafka, with health checks and a circuit breaker.

items.name: utils
items.text: Shared utilities: environment, logging, an HTTP client, IDs, crypto, dates and validation.

items.name: grill
items.text: An interview-prep app. Browse curated questions, then add your own notes and bookmarks, stored locally.
